tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background (`bg-background` on body). The ground for `foreground` and `muted-foreground`.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on `background`, `card`, `popover`, `muted` and `secondary`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and Alert surface. Raised one step above `background` in dark.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Surface of Popover, Dropdown menu, Select, Combobox and Command panels.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The brand purple. Default Button and Badge fill, links (`link` variant), checked Checkbox, Switch and Radio, Progress bar. Use for the one main action per view.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` in both themes.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary Button and Badge fill. Neutral, quieter than `primary`.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost and outline Buttons, Skeleton, Tabs list, Kbd.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, placeholders, helper text. Reads at 4.5:1 or more on `background` and `card`; on `muted` in light it is near the floor, so keep it for short hints there.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Highlighted row in menus, Command and Combobox items (focus or hover).

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and delete actions. Text on `background` and `card`; as a fill only at 10% (light) or 20% (dark) under destructive text. Also the `aria-invalid` border.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Cautions that are not errors, such as a broken rule or a risky choice. Tailwind amber-800 (light) and amber-300 (dark). Text on `background`, `card` and `popover` (7:1 light, 13:1 dark); as a fill only at 10% (light) or 20% (dark) under `warning` text, like `destructive`. Lighter than `destructive` in dark and darker in light, but always pair it with a word or a WarningIcon so it is not told apart by color alone.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default border on every element (`* { border-border }`), Separator, outline Button and Badge. Decorative only: under 3:1, so never the only sign of a control's edge.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Field fill: Input, Textarea, Select trigger use `input` at 50% opacity. Unchecked Switch track.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring and focus border (`focus-visible:border-ring` plus a 3px `ring` at 30–50%). As shipped it is under 3:1 on `background`; the solid border carries the focus state.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, the lightest purple. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3, the most saturated purple.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. Equals light `primary`.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5, the darkest purple. Equals dark `primary`. The five steps differ in lightness, so series stay apart without hue.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar panel surface.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active item and brand mark in the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered or selected sidebar menu item.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge and its group separators.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Badge, xs Button, Kbd, table captions, helper text.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: The default UI size: body copy, card text, menus, fields on desktop.
styles.sample: Your team is saved after each battle.

styles.name: text-base
styles.usage: Inputs on mobile (stops iOS zoom), long reading text.
styles.sample: Catch only the first encounter on each route.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button text, Label, Alert title, menu group labels.

styles.name: mono-xs
styles.usage: Keyboard hints, IDs, seeds and other code-like text.
styles.sample: Press d to toggle dark mode

spacing.note: Tailwind v4 scale: one step is 0.25rem (4px). Listed are the steps the components use.

tokens.name: spacing-0.5
tokens.usage: Badge vertical padding, Alert title-to-description gap.

tokens.name: spacing-1
tokens.usage: Icon gap in sm and xs Buttons and in Badges.

tokens.name: spacing-1.5
tokens.usage: Icon gap in default and lg Buttons; CardHeader row gap.

tokens.name: spacing-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; xs Button inline padding with an icon.

tokens.name: spacing-2.5
tokens.usage: Button side padding next to an icon; Alert icon gap.

tokens.name: spacing-3
tokens.usage: Button and Input side padding; Alert vertical padding.

tokens.name: spacing-4
tokens.usage: Alert side padding, lg Button padding, small Card padding (`size="sm"`).

tokens.name: spacing-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and gap between Card sections (`--card-spacing`).

radius.note: All steps come from the base `radius` (0.625rem) times a factor. Values below are resolved.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base. Change this one value to scale every radius.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: radius × 0.6. Not used by the shipped components; keep for small inner parts. (Checkbox uses a literal 5px.)

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: radius × 0.8. Not used by the shipped components; keep for small inner parts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: radius × 1. Kbd, Tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: radius × 1.4. Item rows, Tooltip, sidebar menu items.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: radius × 1.8. Alert, Accordion, Textarea, Skeleton, Toast, Tabs list, and menu items inside Dropdown, Select and Combobox.

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: radius × 2.2. Input, Badge, Popover, and the Dropdown, Select and Combobox panels. At input height this reads as a pill.

tokens.name: radius-4xl
tokens.usage: radius × 2.6. Button (a pill at h-9), Card, Dialog, Alert dialog, Drawer.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switch, Radio, Progress, Tabs indicator, Drawer handle.

shadow.note: Tailwind v4 default shadows. Cards and overlays also add a 1px `foreground` ring at 5% (light) or 10% (dark) in place of a border.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Switch thumb, inset sidebar.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Card, Navigation menu viewport.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Popover, Dropdown menu, Select and Combobox panels, Toast.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Dialog, Alert dialog, Drawer, Sheet.
